description: Principal attributes built by CerbosPrincipalBuilder. Validated on every Cerbos check request.

userId.description: Internal domain user identifier for human principals. Allows policies to compare platform user ownership even when an external subject is used as the principal id.

is_machine.description: Whether the principal represents an API-key machine caller instead of an interactive human user.

isInstanceAdmin.description: Whether the principal is an instance-level administrator.

tenantMemberships.description: Map of tenantId to role string (e.g. 'admin') for tenant membership checks.

orgMemberships.description: Map of organizationId to role string (e.g. 'admin') for organization membership checks.

groupMemberships.description: Map of groupId to role string for group administration checks.

groupMemberCreateScopes.description: Exact tenantId/groupId scopes for current group administration or group_member:create permission.

groupMemberUpdateScopes.description: Exact tenantId/groupId scopes for current group administration or group_member:update permission.

groupMemberDeleteScopes.description: Exact tenantId/groupId scopes for current group administration or group_member:delete permission.

eventCreateOrganizations.description: Organization IDs where the human principal has event:create permission.

eventCreateGroups.description: Group IDs where the human principal has event:create permission.

eventFinanceOrganizations.description: Organization IDs where the human principal has event:manage-finance permission.

eventFinanceGroups.description: Group IDs where the human principal has event:manage-finance permission.

eventAssignments.description: Map of eventId to effective assignment data. Only active, non-expired assignments for the request tenant are hydrated by CerbosPrincipalBuilder.EnrichWithEventAssignmentsAsync.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier used to bind an event assignment to the resource tenant.

nowUtc.description: Current UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format for lifecycle time comparisons.
